messages.text:
The first verifier run found a real parser boundary bug: negative numeric literals inside Nushell lists were being read as subtraction, so `[34 -44]` became a single value.

I’m patching the tokenizer and a few diagnostic/stability edges now; this is exactly the kind of failure the live oracle is meant to catch before final delivery.

commands.commandLine: python -m py_compile .\nushell_port.py; python .\executable -c "{a: 9, b: [34 -44]} | to json --raw"; python .\executable -c "3 + "; python .\executable -c "[1 2] | get 9"
